title: Signal Station
author: Luke Steuber
description:
Chat from your wrist with the language model you choose. Ask a general question or follow up in the same conversation. Optionally bring selected readings and saved history into chat. The phone keeps full conversations; the watch shows a short, scrollable reply.

Install the separate Signal Station Android app first:
https://dr.eamer.dev/downloads/apps/signal-station/

On your Android phone, tap Download for Android, open the APK, allow installation from your browser if asked, and tap Install. Open Signal Station, go to Ask, choose Set up answers, and add your provider, model and key. Provider usage charges apply. Capture and local History need no key.

Keep your usual Pebble app installed and your watch paired there. In Signal Station on the phone, open Settings, Connected devices, Watch connection. Choose your Pebble app and watch, then tap Check connection.

Open Signal Station on the watch. The right-side buttons are Up for Capture, middle for Ask, and Down for History. Up/Down scroll replies; Back returns home. Dictation depends on watch support. Read full formatted responses and open links on the phone.

Still in testing. By Luke Steuber.
releaseNotes: Replies now use a compact Markdown layout with headings, lists, quotes and literal code. Shortened replies point to the full answer on Android. Updated Android installation and chat instructions. Still in testing.
